acceptance.state: GREEN on the household factorial; financial pairing pending
GREEN (prefix invariance, leaky control fails) / fold-change rule xfail
GREEN on the household factorial / min_delta+floor xfail
GREEN (delta from causal train scale; grid declared)
GREEN (both signs kept) / temporal blocks xfail
GREEN on the household factorial / financial delivery xfail

comparability.resolution: a re-execution of a reference method under this contract (MATCHED_DOMAIN_COMPARISON) is the planned comparison
comparability.why: no literature reference re-executed on this task yet

benchmark_contract.metric_aggregation: per horizon, fold, seed and arm; paired
benchmark_contract.metric_formula: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sd_train per horizon and fold; RMSE_z; skill = 1 - MAE_z_model/MAE_z_naive
benchmark_contract.metric_scale: z (fold train sigma); original units secondarily
benchmark_contract.missing_policy: non-finite bars withdrawn; weekend gaps kept as gaps (no fill)
benchmark_contract.naive_baseline: persistence at the horizon on identical rows
notes: no literature reference bound yet: NOT_COMPARABLE until a matched re-execution exists
benchmark_contract.scaler_fit_population: train rows of the fold, shared by every arm
benchmark_contract.split_rule: weekly walk-forward folds; retraining weekly; reserve from 2025-01-01 unread
benchmark_contract.target_construction: hourly bar close, as served; horizons declared by the task before scoring
benchmark_contract.tuning_budget: equal, declared per loss family; defaults arm explicit

hosts.blocks: all four recipes of a (seed, horizon) on one host; seeds spread across hosts only when the wrapper and environment are identical

larger_business_receiver.channels: the business configs' feature sets (phase 3/4 window 144)
larger_business_receiver.core: tcn_w with width chosen by a declared rule at pilot
larger_business_receiver.parameters: measured at pilot; capacity declared, not required to reach a million

receivers.rule: both receivers run every recipe; no recipe is compared across receivers

reporting.inference: paired by week/origin and seed; intervals respecting temporal blocks; multiplicity declared
reporting.precision: predictions and targets saved without rounding; metrics accumulated in float64 and cross-checked by an independent calculator; dtype, reload and backend variation recorded
reporting.scale: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sigma_train per fold, shared by every arm; RMSE_z; skill = 1 - MAE_z_model/MAE_z_naive; original units secondarily

search.budget_unit: DEV fits per family per horizon (equal, declared)
search.decay_note: the cumulative product of (1 - lr_t*decay) describes shrinkage due to decay ONLY; it orients candidates with width, data and duration and is not an optimal-value formula; muP scaling rules do not transfer to a network without that parameterisation

defaults_arm.note: the installed version's explicit defaults; not the owner's historical optimum, which is not recovered

search.selection: validation MAE_z on DEV folds only; the reserve is never queried
search.weight_groups_adamw: decay applied to kernels; bias and normalisation parameters excluded (declared)

folds.dev_folds: the last 26 weeks before 2025-01-01 as DEV; the reserve stays closed
folds.why_candidates: four years is the owner's antecedent, not a minimum; 52/104/208 weeks are declared candidates judged by regime coverage and learning curves on DEV folds only

long.why: the recalled ~3 days becomes 72 hourly steps; both are declared BEFORE any score and are not recovered configs

short.why: the owner's recalled 6 h is an antecedent; 6 hourly steps is declared here as the short horizon and justified as one quarter of a trading day at this resolution

task.missing_policy: non-finite bars withdrawn; weekend gaps stay gaps
task.naive: persistence at each horizon on identical rows

what_this_is_not: not a run, not a winner, not a trading loss; the household factorial is a preserved antecedent (12 fits, one task) and selects nothing financial
